stage0077_03:r_1c0f94acd5a8a143.text: ～ $$ローナン・マーセナス$$'s Private Residence ～

stage0077_03:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$リディ$$
「...I hear the Unicorn's been captured
　by Neo Zeon.」

stage0077_03:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$リディ$$
「Worried about where the box ended up?
　Or is it about $$バナージ$$...」

stage0077_03:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$リディ$$
「...I've left your care to my father.
　If you ever need anything, just
　tell me each time.」

stage0077_03:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$リディ$$
「Dakar. Since it's the place the Laplace
　Program pointed to, Neo Zeon is bound
　to show up there.」

stage0077_03:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$リディ$$
（Father only mentioned Chrono's name,
　and won't say anything more than that...）

stage0077_03:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$リディ$$
（The box, and Chrono...
　The things that bind me and $$オードリー$$...
　$$ミネバ$$...）

stage0077_03:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$リディ$$
（If only the box didn't exist,
　could we be free...）

stage0077_03:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$カークス$$
「...All preparations for the invasion
　of Dakar are complete.」

stage0077_03:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Well done, Major $$カークス$$.」

stage0077_03:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$カークス$$
「No... all our officers and soldiers
　are grateful to you, Colonel, for the
　chance to fight.」

stage0077_03:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「The Zeon remnants within the atmosphere...
　So they'll all gather in one place.」

stage0077_03:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「And what of that mobile armor?」

stage0077_03:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$ロニ$$
「Yes...!
　It's operating without issue, and should
　serve as the core of the Dakar invasion.」

stage0077_03:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「So you're Ensign $$ロニ・ガーベイ$$.
　...I know of your father.
　I expect great things.」

stage0077_03:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$ロニ$$
「Thank you.
　My life exists to avenge my father,
　my mother, and our fallen comrades.」

stage0077_03:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「All I can do is support your will and
　provide material aid.
　But let me say just this.」

stage0077_03:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「May those who carry on Mahdi's will
　be blessed.」

stage0077_03:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Now then, Captain...
　See to the Unicorn as arranged.」

stage0077_03:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「I understand the Captain's concerns.
　But isn't this what you wanted, when you
　came under my command?」

stage0077_03:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Faced with the world's crisis, the
　Supreme Commander chose the rational
　path. But that leaves feelings with nowhere to go.」

stage0077_03:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「What I'm doing is giving those
　adrift feelings somewhere to flow.」

stage0077_03:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$ロニ$$
「We agreed with the Colonel's thinking,
　and that's why we rallied here.」

stage0077_03:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Then, Major $$カークス$$, Ensign $$ロニ$$...
　I'll await good news.」

stage0077_03:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$ロニ$$
「Leave it to us, Colonel $$フル・フロンタル$$.」

stage0077_03:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$フラスト$$
「Even the Colonel knows you're aboard
　the $$ガランシェール$$.
　No need to hide.」

stage0077_03:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$バナージ$$
「I just didn't want to face him.」

stage0077_03:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$アレク$$
「Then you could've just stayed
　in the hangar.」

stage0077_03:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$バナージ$$
「I wanted to hear what he'd say
　to $$ロニ$$.」

stage0077_03:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$アレク$$
「That so. Quite the delicate
　matter.」

stage0077_03:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$フラスト$$
「Don't say that, $$アレク$$.
　The kid's got a soft spot for that
　girl, $$ロニ$$.」

stage0077_03:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$アレク$$
「I see. Sounds like love at first
　sight, for both of them.」

stage0077_03:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$ロニ$$
「I did think fondly of you...」

stage0077_03:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$ロニ$$
「Once the battle's over, let's talk a lot.
　I want to know more... about you.」

stage0077_03:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Um, uh... $$ロニ$$...
　This might sound strange coming
　from me, but...」

stage0077_03:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「Once we drop them off, the $$ガランシェール$$
　waits outside the area.」

stage0077_03:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$バナージ$$
（Because of the Laplace Program,
　Neo Zeon... no, Zeon will attack Dakar...）

stage0077_03:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$ジノ$$
「The $$大統領$$ and everyone gathered here,
　please evacuate, just in case.」

stage0077_03:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$ナナリー$$
（$c...
　I hear $$ゼロ$$ is there...）

stage0077_03:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$ナナリー$$
「It's all right, $$リリーナ$$.
　Let's evacuate first, to make sure
　we're safe.」

stage0077_03:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$カガリ$$
「That's right.
　We have to end this war with Neo Zeon
　in our own way.」

stage0077_03:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$$マリナ$$
「I understand your unease, $$シーリン$$.
　There are people who find us,
　as we are, unwelcome.」

stage0077_03:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$マリナ$$
「But not everyone in the world is like
　that. There's $c, fighting desperately
　out there, and those who want peace...」

stage0077_03:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$リリーナ$$
「Let's do our best for people like
　that too, $$シーリン$$.」

stage0077_03:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$シーリン$$
「...You're quite right.
　That's exactly why we've all
　gathered here.」

stage0077_03:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
???
「The $$大統領$$ and his faction, is it!
　You'll come quietly!」

stage0077_03:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$ジノ$$
「Impossible! You mean security's
　already been breached!?」

stage0077_03:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
???
「Sieg Zeon!
　You, enemies of Zeon, we will purge!」

stage0077_03:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$アーニャ$$
「You, who aren't even Zeon?」

stage0077_03:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$アーニャ$$
「The way you talk... you've got no
　Zeon accent at all, and your 'Sieg Zeon'
　sounds off too.」

stage0077_03:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$$アーニャ$$
「Pathetic...
　Not even trying to hide it now.」

stage0077_03:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
???
「Don't think two SP agents can handle
　a number like this!」

stage0077_03:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
???
「Dead men tell no tales...!
　Prepare yourself...」

stage0077_03:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$ジェレミア$$
「I will not forgive those who would
　crush the world's hope for the future...!」

stage0077_03:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$ジェレミア$$
「It's quite all right, $$ジノ$$.
　That name is proof of my loyalty...」

stage0077_03:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$ジェレミア$$
「And it's also the name of my farm.」

stage0077_03:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
$$アーニャ$$
「Is the farm doing all right?」

stage0077_03:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$$ジェレミア$$
「It's just between the Valencia and
　navel seasons right now.
　I've time enough to reap some villains.」

stage0077_03:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$$クラウス$$
「What about the other thieves...」

stage0077_03:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$$ジェレミア$$
「No need to worry about that either.」

stage0077_03:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$咲世子$$
「Things outside are handled as well.」

stage0077_03:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$咲世子$$
「It's been a while, Lady $$ナナリー$$.
　This time, on $$ゼロ$$'s orders, I've been
　guarding you from the shadows.」

stage0077_03:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$レディ$$
「Saved by his keen insight, were you.
　Still as shrewd as ever.」

stage0077_03:r_f527e012803f7f1c.text:
$$ジェレミア$$
「Still, $$咲世子$$...
　Even for you, that was quite fast.」

stage0077_03:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$$咲世子$$
「I had some people who lent a hand.」

stage0077_03:r_338f3b27e51dcc41.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「I'm glad you're all safe.」

stage0077_03:r_d91d4bc2d52b61c4.text:
$$リリーナ$$
「Was it you who saved us?」

stage0077_03:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「If it was Chrono's people who targeted
　your lives, then it's Chrono's people
　who protect them too.」

stage0077_03:r_4dbfba00ba7744ee.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「I am $$アドヴェント$$...
　field captain of the Chrono Reformists.」

stage0077_03:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
$$バナージ$$
「They're just indiscriminately
　burning down the city!」

stage0077_03:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
$$バナージ$$
「I'm taking the Unicorn out!
　If the Laplace Program's seal breaks,
　there's no reason to keep this up, is there!?」

stage0077_03:r_3ff2e21207d1d1d3.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「No.
　Wait until the cleanup is finished.」

stage0077_03:r_e51ecf6d6aa42e75.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Cleanup, huh...!?
　Innocent people could end up bleeding for this!
　Are you all right with that!?」

stage0077_03:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「I told you, it's the operation.
　There's no right or wrong about it.」

stage0077_03:r_8805f96e52aaa462.text:
$$バナージ$$
「I'm taking out the Unicorn.」

stage0077_03:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「I don't recall tying you up and dragging you here.
　If you think it wasn't supposed to be like this,
　that's just your lack of imagination.」

stage0077_03:r_eaa52d152f444bfd.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「This is what it means to take enemy territory.」

stage0077_03:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Shooting bystanders, trampling those who flee...!
　This isn't even war!
　It's just paying back old grudges!」

stage0077_03:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
$$バナージ$$
「The Captain isn't someone who'd do this!
　You can't possibly be okay with this!
　Please, make it stop!」

stage0077_03:r_7cbc63dad295f862.text:
$$バナージ$$
「If you're telling me this is war,
　why did you take me out to the desert!?」

stage0077_03:r_07f53c816e0a51f5.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Why did you put Ms. $$マリーダ$$ in the
　$$ガランシェール$$ unit!? The reason she calls
　you Master isn't because she's an Enhanced Human!」

stage0077_03:r_2d09c6f6a2d990ea.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Because, the same way I was, the Captain saved her heart...」

stage0077_03:r_48c6c1ecfea6fe4a.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「The only reason I cared about you is because
　you're the key to the box! I just thought it'd be
　convenient to keep you on a leash!」

stage0077_03:r_2b3479c4cf0680f4.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「You said this isn't war, didn't you?
　Open your eyes and take a good look!」

stage0077_03:r_e370696b8936b08c.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「This is what war is, things like this happening!
　No ideals, no honor, no dignity!
　There's just those who kill and those who get killed!」

stage0077_03:r_9d7b02c5e728b7aa.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「What's wrong with paying back old grudges!
　Our war still isn't over!」

stage0077_03:r_9af213fc64e0afec.text:
$$バナージ$$
「That's...!
　Isn't that the same logic as the Federation
　forces that burned Zeon's cities!?」

stage0077_03:r_0c705091f748360e.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Because it's sad... people live so as not
　to feel sad anymore. That's what you told me!」

stage0077_03:r_a072aa25e5f521e0.text:
$$バナージ$$
「You know it too!
　That doing this won't get you anything back!」

stage0077_03:r_24e1a808a1609a1a.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「You don't know anything, you brat!」

stage0077_03:r_53128ce8f154fd06.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「I'm...! We've been waiting for this moment
　for so long! I'd love to get down there
　and help out myself, right now!」

stage0077_03:r_03b5db9ce98fb8d6.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Even so...!
　Just because you've seen hell yourself,
　that doesn't mean you can force it on others!」

stage0077_03:r_3915fb4102f1c1dd.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「If you don't quit that mouth of yours, I really will...!」

stage0077_03:r_817b2773b4ed563e.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Not with words like that...!!」

stage0077_03:r_1cc233cbc8c80af7.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「Deal with this guy! $$アレク$$, $$フラスト$$!」

stage0077_03:r_3ce2f3e58cfdc3ba.text:
$$フラスト$$
「Sorry, but my hands are full right now.
　You'll have to handle him yourself.」

stage0077_03:r_e598c2a0b27e7f50.text:
$$バナージ$$
「I don't understand...
　I just don't understand, at all...」

stage0077_03:r_4d2a9066c4e7b27f.text:
$$バナージ$$
「But just because I don't understand...
　just because there's too much sadness,
　I can't let myself stop feeling it!」

stage0077_03:r_23a9c7ab620ab112.text:
$$バナージ$$
「I...! I don't want to forget
　that people have sadness... that they have
　hearts that can feel sad!」

stage0077_03:r_4f0aca6deda07883.text:
$$バナージ$$
「I want to become someone who can accept that!
　Just like you, Captain!」

stage0077_03:r_ff4ce5f3cf96b617.text:
$$アレク$$
「Are we sure we don't need to stop him?」

stage0077_03:r_d73c21f119847e35.text:
$$フラスト$$
「Leave it.
　Let the kid do as he likes... right, Captain?」

stage0077_03:r_c2df6b71e3b4b6ec.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
（That guy... he really hasn't died yet, after all...）

stage0077_03:r_2ddff5064af78db4.text:
$$ブライト$$
「...How is $$バナージ$$ doing?」

stage0077_03:r_050d0532c4b24bfe.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「After hearing about $$オードリー$$ from Ensign $$リディ$$,
　he dropped off to sleep like he'd passed out.」

stage0077_03:r_d583fcea31bdad2e.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Syncing his consciousness with the Mobile Armor's
　pilot seems to have worn him out badly.」

stage0077_03:r_475f7653621a91b5.text:
$$ブライト$$
「The new coordinates the Laplace Program showed?」

stage0077_03:r_f228ae702350849b.text:
$$アムロ$$
「He said he has no intention of talking about that.」

stage0077_03:r_d69dc027cba3003f.text:
$$ブライト$$
「...Fine.
　Rather than get tossed around by some unseen
　ghost of the past, we have things we must do.」

stage0077_03:r_3c3735172a480b72.text:
$$アムロ$$
「$$アンチスパイラル#keyword$$...
　To work out a countermeasure against it, we need
　to link up with Japan's forces.」

stage0077_03:r_1f418b5594cea300.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「That Mobile Armor pilot... what's going to happen to them?」

stage0077_03:r_f87fb889124bfaef.text:
$$ブライト$$
「Right now they're in a dangerous state, mind and
　body worn down. Treatment comes first.」

stage0077_03:r_33f7fd55913419e8.text:
$$アムロ$$
「But $$バナージ$$ saved a life.
　That's one possibility for breaking the chain of hatred.」

stage0077_03:r_4de6ac85c63bac12.text:
$$ブライト$$
「I heard the report from Captain $$オットー$$.
　...This time, I'll overlook your going off on your own.」

stage0077_03:r_6d77e72dbbcd7dfe.text:
$$ブライト$$
「Right now, your eyes are the eyes of someone
　who wants somebody else to erase their doubts.」

stage0077_03:r_9dc59affd40f32fc.text:
$$ブライト$$
「If you want punishment, just say so.
　If that'll clear away your self-loathing,
　I'll give you as much as you want.」

stage0077_03:r_0cea115be526a319.text:
$$ブライト$$
「But that way, you'll stay a half-baked man forever.
　I can't send someone like that onto the battlefield.」

stage0077_03:r_09ee921a85025fd3.text:
$$ブライト$$
「Cool your head a little.
　...$c is headed for Japan.
　I'm sure the next fight will come soon enough.」

stage0077_03:r_91c6d0bb53854ecc.text:
$$ブライト$$
「...Glad to have you back.」

stage0077_03:r_42a3149105314ab8.text:
$$リディ$$
「...Because this is the only place I belong...」

stage0077_03:r_62ecd978c667bd29.text:
$$アムロ$$
「It's only been a week, but it seems
　a lot has happened.」

stage0077_03:r_d441e6cc908ac01b.text:
$$ブライト$$
「It's a family matter, I'd guess.
　He hated the Marcenas name and joined the
　military, yet he still relied on that family.」

stage0077_03:r_b2aab8873350ea1f.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Do you think he can climb back up?」

stage0077_03:r_2c7af4c55d8ac938.text:
$$ブライト$$
「If he breaks, then that's all he ever was.
　A shame, but there it is.」

stage0077_03:r_653b741d07545dff.text:
$$アムロ$$
「His talent isn't bad...
　But whether he can make use of it is up to him.」

stage0077_03:r_f97e6925c9e37332.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「The way Ensign $$リディ$$ looks at
　$$バナージ$$ has me a little concerned.」

stage0077_03:r_2b93cca10f1c36a8.text:
$$フォウ$$
「People meet each other, all sorts of
　feelings are born, and then they hurt
　each other...」

stage0077_03:r_7980fd37141d88d0.text:
$$フォウ$$
「But if you keep living, good things happen too.
　Like this, getting to see $$カミーユ$$ again.」

stage0077_03:r_a26e2108358af7a4.text:
$$グラハム$$
「Meetings and partings...
　A person's fate is a strange thing.」

stage0077_03:r_a8118b2e37aa1382.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「And now you've come to fight alongside me.
　Both of us, with our masks cast aside.」

stage0077_03:r_017a56991b7b8ca4.text:
$$グラハム$$
「One of my long-held dreams is finally coming true.」

stage0077_03:r_ad3e1db3419665fb.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「I'd like to introduce you to $$刹那$$, if I may...」

stage0077_03:r_0149e3a5f2e5ef78.text:
$$グラハム$$
「No... I'll have to decline that.
　I'm not yet a man who can face him.」

stage0077_03:r_3ad10e705167a3fa.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「If it comes to that, then I...」

stage0077_03:r_bdc546b199c80996.text:
$$グラハム$$
「Mine is just an excuse.
　...Truthfully, I'm only afraid of having him
　see through to my own weakness.」

stage0077_03:r_22c8caf8c08c5119.text:
$$グラハム$$
「Neither my wings, the $$ブレイヴ$$, nor I myself,
　have reached completion yet...」

stage0077_03:r_9c13714b3efbc7a8.text:
$$グラハム$$
「To speak with him someday, head held high...
　that's my goal for now.」

stage0077_03:r_96f156e19b53fc09.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「That resolve... I'll respect it.
　Welcome, $$グラハム・エーカー$$.」

stage0077_03:r_feb0390bba7fe1fb.text:
$$グラハム$$
「My thanks, $$ゼクス・マーキス$$.」

stage0077_03:r_8a78bcec22029401.text:
$$グラハム$$
（Boy... no, $$刹那・Ｆ・セイエイ$$...
　This life you saved... I'll repay it, someday.）

stage0077_03:r_f42017dfce31dea9.text:
$$ブライト$$
「...How is $$バナージ$$ doing?」

stage0077_03:r_ef7426919f628d8a.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「After hearing about $$オードリー$$ from Ensign $$リディ$$,
　he dropped off to sleep like he'd passed out.」

stage0077_03:r_9e994a4b926d9906.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Syncing his consciousness with the Mobile Armor's
　pilot seems to have worn him out badly.」

stage0077_03:r_ffae76d2a77abf5a.text:
$$ブライト$$
「The new coordinates the Laplace Program showed?」

stage0077_03:r_3ac462d37e5893ff.text:
$$アムロ$$
「He said he has no intention of talking about that.」

stage0077_03:r_fd6bdf7910d7d925.text:
$$ブライト$$
「...Fine.
　Rather than get tossed around by some unseen
　ghost of the past, we have things we must do.」

stage0077_03:r_d38be46e6cd7a5e5.text:
$$アムロ$$
「$$アンチスパイラル#keyword$$...
　To work out a countermeasure against it, we need
　to link up with Japan's forces.」

stage0077_03:r_c66844158d1ce600.text:
$$ブライト$$
「I heard the report from Captain $$オットー$$.
　...This time, I'll overlook your going off on your own.」

stage0077_03:r_554ae12c4c170253.text:
$$ブライト$$
「Right now, your eyes are the eyes of someone
　who wants somebody else to erase their doubts.」

stage0077_03:r_fa59c6df081e6ae4.text:
$$ブライト$$
「If you want punishment, just say so.
　If that'll clear away your self-loathing,
　I'll give you as much as you want.」

stage0077_03:r_ca3edf3b8b52aedf.text:
$$ブライト$$
「But that way, you'll stay a half-baked man forever.
　I can't send someone like that onto the battlefield.」

stage0077_03:r_0b3b19cddb871f90.text:
$$ブライト$$
「Cool your head a little.
　...$c is headed for Japan.
　I'm sure the next fight will come soon enough.」

stage0077_03:r_b740d817a14afd3a.text:
$$ブライト$$
「...Glad to have you back.」

stage0077_03:r_40e4c010d1b35b4c.text:
$$リディ$$
「...Because this is the only place I belong...」

stage0077_03:r_c33abf00683a32bc.text:
$$アムロ$$
「It's only been a week, but it seems
　a lot has happened.」

stage0077_03:r_3036adce91d1f4a8.text:
$$ブライト$$
「It's a family matter, I'd guess.
　He hated the Marcenas name and joined the
　military, yet he still relied on that family.」

stage0077_03:r_019293cb83599509.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Do you think he can climb back up?」

stage0077_03:r_9b949b9281aaeef1.text:
$$ブライト$$
「If he breaks, then that's all he ever was.
　A shame, but there it is.」

stage0077_03:r_b39a1dd705fe6cbf.text:
$$アムロ$$
「His talent isn't bad...
　But whether he can make use of it is up to him.」

stage0077_03:r_cf907a4d5de8b5c9.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「The way Ensign $$リディ$$ looks at
　$$バナージ$$ has me a little concerned.」

stage0077_03:r_9133b7e0b34de48f.text:
$$フォウ$$
「People meet each other, all sorts of
　feelings are born, and then they hurt
　each other...」

stage0077_03:r_4ae9c4bd77494c4a.text:
$$フォウ$$
「But if you keep living, good things happen too.
　Like this, getting to see $$カミーユ$$ again.」

stage0077_03:r_a84ab0c3c1ba44d4.text:
$$グラハム$$
「Meetings and partings...
　A person's fate is a strange thing.」

stage0077_03:r_414e6e90094d1413.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「And now you've come to fight alongside me.
　Both of us, with our masks cast aside.」

stage0077_03:r_83a9e41e15444c69.text:
$$グラハム$$
「One of my long-held dreams is finally coming true.」

stage0077_03:r_09227dec2bd6f4d8.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「I'd like to introduce you to $$刹那$$, if I may...」

stage0077_03:r_7b3a37f5039eb1f6.text:
$$グラハム$$
「No... I'll have to decline that.
　I'm not yet a man who can face him.」

stage0077_03:r_cb6d9ee71c24b042.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「If it comes to that, then I...」

stage0077_03:r_ddd97a6ef823929a.text:
$$グラハム$$
「Mine is just an excuse.
　...Truthfully, I'm only afraid of having him
　see through to my own weakness.」

stage0077_03:r_df349052cd9cdd0c.text:
$$グラハム$$
「Neither my wings, the $$ブレイヴ$$, nor I myself,
　have reached completion yet...」

stage0077_03:r_a7ce9f908380694c.text:
$$グラハム$$
「To speak with him someday, head held high...
　that's my goal for now.」

stage0077_03:r_de3cc1f733dcb073.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「That resolve... I'll respect it.
　Welcome, $$グラハム・エーカー$$.」

stage0077_03:r_0835ec3fff318aff.text:
$$グラハム$$
「My thanks, $$ゼクス・マーキス$$.」

stage0077_03:r_c32efc7394910997.text:
$$グラハム$$
（Boy... no, $$刹那・Ｆ・セイエイ$$...
　This life you saved... I'll repay it, someday.）

stage0077_03:r_5d8b67b5bd8ce190.text:
$$大統領$$
「...Then, per today's resolution: this coming
　November 1st, we will disclose $$エタニティ・フラット$$ to
　every citizen, in and outside the Federation」

stage0077_03:r_7cf3c91395139f5c.text:
$$レディ$$
「I wonder if $c can encounter the
　singularity before then...」

stage0077_03:r_6ccd85652ef4ccf1.text:
$$トライア$$
「No use worrying about it. Everyone will
　start noticing something's wrong by then
　anyway.」

stage0077_03:r_fbe7bf7d854012a7.text:
$$トライア$$
「However things turn out, everyone
　needs to know the truth.」

stage0077_03:r_1f438885dbc1359e.text:
$$リリーナ$$
「Ideally, the singularity would be found
　before then, so all humanity could choose
　between fighting $$バアル$$ and $$エタニティ・フラット$$...」

stage0077_03:r_2e59226caa35f6e5.text:
$$カガリ$$
「True, in $$ＵＣＷ$$, conditions came together and
　we performed $$時空修復$$ with all humanity's
　consent, but doing that again is impossible...」

stage0077_03:r_5d7a3adb077ad934.text:
$$トライア$$
「How to unify humanity's will is something
　we can work out later. The problem is the
　process of getting there.」

stage0077_03:r_78d3b2a75e38d6f7.text:
$$マリナ$$
「About a month left until November 1st...
　I wonder what we can do before then...」

stage0077_03:r_8d461de418389bf8.text:
$$ナナリー$$
「If we keep repeating chains of hatred
　like today's, we'll never bring people's
　hearts together.」

stage0077_03:r_5cb2acefa1e7c7fb.text:
$$マリナ$$
「Then let's stop that chain of hatred.」

stage0077_03:r_33f67c683bda9203.text:
$$カガリ$$
「$c is fighting for humanity's sake
　too. Let's do what we can as well.」

stage0077_03:r_476fb20ab9d18957.text:
$$リリーナ$$
「To heal the hearts worn down by Geminis's
　schemes and by war, so people remember
　peace, even a little...」

stage0077_03:r_6be0d6139fac197c.text:
$$マリナ$$
「And so they can hold on to hope
　for the future...」

stage0077_03:r_df899b8031b4ca06.text:
$$ナナリー$$
「Yes...!
　I'll do everything I can too.」

stage0077_03:r_c5d048c7db7cac75.text:
$$ナナリー$$
（I won't lose to Brother and
　$$スザク$$ and the others）

stage0077_03:r_b6ca80db4741a62c.text:
$$レディ$$
「But judging by today's moves as well,
　Chrono will likely interfere with our
　activities.」

stage0077_03:r_432a29155221625f.text:
$$ジノ$$
「Yeah... They've joined hands with Geminis,
　and probably intend to push their Earth
　supremacist agenda through.」

stage0077_03:r_9f7c18d1ea1b55c9.text:
$$アーニャ$$
「But I don't understand...
　Why they hate Spacenoids that much...」

stage0077_03:r_56688ad8e41b7b42.text:
$$ジノ$$
「And since they're in league with
　Geminis, we can assume they want
　$$エタニティ・フラット$$.」

stage0077_03:r_34a510533cb8a9f5.text:
$$レディ$$
「Chrono, lurking in the shadows of
　the Earth Federation... What is it
　they actually want...」

stage0077_03:r_1afedc9fa466f321.text:
$$レディ$$
（And $$アドヴェント$$, who stands against them... He
　didn't say much, but his word 'reformists'
　might be the key to a rift inside Chrono...）

stage0077_03:r_1be6d12f616f04e4.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...Master $$アムロ$$, I have some
　interesting news for you.」

stage0077_03:r_4e91ccecf1dd0f66.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I know, Master $$アムロ$$. You're just
　brimming with interest in that
　phantom mobile suit.」

stage0077_03:r_668b7114a3ac1d77.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You really shot it down so carefully,
　too. Disabling it without damaging the
　power unit even produced a Z-Chip.」

stage0077_03:r_ef339c6f71e7560f.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That comes to 100Z...!
　I'll add this to the squad's stock.」

stage0077_03:r_ce68dd10a19e01ea.text:
$$アムロ$$
「So then, the $$ジュアッグ$$ is...」

stage0077_03:r_13ce8d4e4858b193.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Yes, I recovered it from the battlefield,
　pieced two together into one, and
　restored it.」

stage0077_03:r_075101b23517fbaa.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Do stop by D-Trader later.
　I'll be selling it in a one-time
　special sale.」

stage0077_03:r_13c2ae299018c9ee.text:
$$アムロ$$
「My thanks, $$ＡＧ$$.
　I'll stop by later with $$チェーン$$.」

stage0077_03:r_6f4f8dd80820f5e7.text:
$$アムロ$$
「I'll invite Mr. $$イアン$$ and
　$$アストナージ$$ too. Oh... $$カミーユ$$,
　$$バナージ$$ and $$タクヤ$$ might be interested.」

stage0077_03:r_afa513b4815df4c9.text:
$$アムロ$$
「$$キラ$$ and Sergeant Major $$マオ$$ would like a
　rare unit like that too. $$ミレイナ$$ and $$ヒルデ$$
　would probably like that roundish look too.」

stage0077_03:r_6cf1e5ed68d98bd4.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
（To think he'd be so innocently delighted...
　He was supposed to curse me, 'You Z-Chip
　fiend!' What a miscalculation on my part）

stage0077_03:r_e62eb587b8d34cb9.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
（Well... every now and then, this sort
　of thing isn't so bad, I suppose）

stage0077_03:r_2be6c657d0e12c4b.text:
$$アンドレイ$$
「...I'm glad to see you looking well.」

stage0077_03:r_f89f6c6c4b076e16.text:
$$マリー$$
「You as well, Ensign $$アンドレイ$$.」

stage0077_03:r_7569f965fff4d791.text:
$$アンドレイ$$
「Actually, I've been commissioned
　Lieutenant now, undeserving as I am.」

stage0077_03:r_b43bdba9393d4d68.text:
$$マリー$$
「Lt. Colonel Sergei's will lives
　on in you, doesn't it.」

stage0077_03:r_3ec159d1a3492877.text:
$$アンドレイ$$
「That's my intention, at least,
　though I know I still have far to go.」

stage0077_03:r_4e2fbafa9ebef558.text:
$$マリー$$
「Then I'll look forward to seeing
　what you become.」

stage0077_03:r_bde2e27bac7e3317.text:
$$コーラサワー$$
「That's the way of it, $$アンドレイ$$.
　Do your best once you're back with
　your original unit.」

stage0077_03:r_631834aa1545ba7b.text:
$$アンドレイ$$
「Huh... What will you be doing,
　Lieutenant $$コーラサワー$$?」

stage0077_03:r_0cd6aab432ee5af7.text:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Call me Lieutenant Mannequin.
　If you want to call me $$コーラサワー$$,
　put 'Happy' in front of it.」

stage0077_03:r_c8b75f3bca245a85.text:
$$アレルヤ$$
「So, is that Happy Lieutenant
　$$コーラサワー$$ joining $c?」

stage0077_03:r_b26be73e3c0c8bed.text:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Can't say it too loudly, but this is
　the strongest unit the Federation's
　got. Can't very well skip it, then.」

stage0077_03:r_1a4dc288e81719ee.text:
$$アンドレイ$$
「Understood, Lieutenant.
　I'll report to Brigadier General
　Mannequin myself.」

stage0077_03:r_b8902c992035da79.text:
$$コーラサワー$$
「I appreciate it.
　And while you're at it, tell her
　I love her.」

stage0077_03:r_df10ad0a71c307da.text:
$$アンドレイ$$
「Words like that, please say
　yourself.」

stage0077_03:r_9293c52555ba1457.text:
$$アレルヤ$$
「He's a cheerful one.
　Somehow I expected as much, though.」

stage0077_03:r_ca702b5726ebd4da.text:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Well, yeah. Don't any of you forget
　to put 'Happy' in front when you
　call me, now.」

stage0077_03:r_51ce1d8caa34c103.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well then, I have a request
　straightaway for that Happy
　Master $$コーラサワー$$.」

stage0077_03:r_2c37dd5b8f919a88.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Let's give it our all today too!」

stage0077_03:r_c6937f14a8985c35.text:
$$アレルヤ$$
「You seem less energetic than
　I expected.」

stage0077_03:r_07513334490fbdf9.text:
$$コーラサワー$$
「No... it's just, I'm a soldier.
　I don't really know how you're
　supposed to do this sort of thing...」

stage0077_03:r_082a55c75a163780.text:
$$アンドレイ$$
「...I'm glad to see you looking well.」

stage0077_03:r_fa09fad95980b867.text:
$$マリー$$
「You as well, Ensign $$アンドレイ$$.」

stage0077_03:r_f5507082e5c31362.text:
$$アンドレイ$$
「Actually, I've been commissioned
　Lieutenant now, undeserving as I am.」

stage0077_03:r_3c9956c9d519d2a2.text:
$$マリー$$
「Lt. Colonel Sergei's will lives
　on in you, doesn't it.」

stage0077_03:r_d150caab246bbd7a.text:
$$アンドレイ$$
「That's my intention, at least,
　though I know I still have far to go.」

stage0077_03:r_d23d30b65284f69d.text:
$$マリー$$
「Then I'll look forward to seeing
　what you become.」

stage0077_03:r_b2f67d46499f2bbd.text:
$$コーラサワー$$
「That's the way of it, $$アンドレイ$$.
　Let's both do our best once we're
　back with our original units.」

stage0077_03:r_fc1b13eaa4071b9a.text:
$$アンドレイ$$
「Yes, Lieutenant $$コーラサワー$$.」

stage0077_03:r_c4cdd41ba9207e9c.text:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Call me Lieutenant Mannequin.
　If you want to call me $$コーラサワー$$,
　put 'Happy' in front of it.」

stage0077_03:r_c33c28fb471faf59.text:
$$アンドレイ$$
「Understood, Happy Lieutenant
　$$コーラサワー$$.」

stage0077_03:r_d0fc4899507f74b2.text:
$$アレルヤ$$
「He's a cheerful one.
　Somehow I expected as much, though.」

stage0077_03:r_b69df689192adfc2.text:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Well, yeah. Don't any of you forget
　to put 'Happy' in front when you
　call me, now.」

stage0077_03:r_8a9ac301023aa8d3.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well then, before we part ways,
　I have a request for that Happy
　Master $$コーラサワー$$.」

stage0077_03:r_38f89a2d27debb9e.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Let's give it our all today too!」

stage0077_03:r_e418ba9e04898c28.text:
$$アレルヤ$$
「You seem less energetic than
　I expected.」

stage0077_03:r_88461d9fd17c56e7.text:
$$コーラサワー$$
「No... it's just, I'm a soldier.
　I don't really know how you're
　supposed to do this sort of thing...」
